claims.statement: HIGH asserts for converted temperature > HIGH; INT retirement requires containing-register read and temperature <= corresponding HIGH.
claims.boundary: Setpoint fixed, INT unmasked, polarity known; output aggregation respected.

claims.statement: A register read alone cannot deactivate a qualified enabled output while its converted over-limit condition persists.
